description: Describe an integration in one sentence ("When X happens in A, do Y in B"). patchbay plans it, researches both APIs, generates a connector with tests and a README, then verifies it in a sandbox with up to N repair attempts. Default language is TypeScript (vitest); set lang: "py" for Python 3.12 (pytest). Falls back to the recorded TypeScript replay run when live API keys are missing.

lang.description: Target language. "ts" (default) emits TypeScript+vitest; "py" emits Python 3.12+pytest. Live keys required for "py".

name: build_connector
title: Build a connector
